propositions: A new entrypoint commit_and_push_tickets_branch must acquire write lock, inspect dirty tree, stage and commit tracker changes with optional supplied git identity, then delegate to push_tickets_branch for delivery.

The entrypoint must reject rebase/merge-recovery states before staging: strict mode raises PushDeliveryError with merge-recovery-blocked reason; default mode warns and returns preserving content for recovery.
Supplied author name/email are applied per-commit via git -c without mutating global or repository config; ambient identity is used when omitted.
Clean but locally-ahead trees must push without creating empty commits; persistent rejection under strict mode preserves the local commit and raises PushDeliveryError rather than success.

Strict lock, stage, or commit failures raise PushDeliveryError with named reasons (commit-lock-timeout, stage-failed, commit-failed); default mode logs warning and returns without invoking push, retaining uncommitted content for later retry.
Direct push_tickets_branch remains push-only and must never stage or commit a dirty tracker.
